notes.text: SALARY MODEL: split. base_salary = retribuzione tabellare; fixed_allowances per level: CONTINGENZA (frozen) + EDR (10.33, frozen since Protocollo 1992) + EDR_RINNOVO (new EDR from 2025-07-01, per level, 14 mensilita) + INDENNITA_FUNZIONE (Q1=67.00, Q2=51.00 only).

SALARY TABLE: 2024-2026 contract signed 23/05/2025, validity 01/01/2024-31/12/2026. Two salary tranches: T1 from 01/07/2025 (+60 EUR at C2, riparametrate), T2 from 01/08/2026 (+100 EUR at C2, riparametrate). New EDR (EDR_RINNOVO) introduced from 01/07/2025: 40.00 EUR at C2, riparametrate per level, paid for 14 mensilita.

SIMPLIFICATION: T0 salary table (valid_from 2024-01-01, valid_until 2025-06-30) back-calculated from T1 minus riparametrated increment. Pre-2025-07-01 values are derived, not sourced from an official table. Results for dates before 2025-07-01 should not be relied upon.

limitation.remediation: Source the pre-July 2025 salary table from an official ANAV table.

notes.text: SIMPLIFICATION: Seniority amounts (cadence_months=24, max 9 tranches) taken from kitech.it tables for IC36, which show identical values to IC35 (ANIASA). Cross-contract borrowing — verify against official ANAV CCNL text.

limitation.remediation: Verify the seniority amounts against the official ANAV CCNL text.

notes.text: HOURLY DIVISOR: 173, consistent with 40h/week x 52/12 = 173.33 convention; ADDITIONAL MONTHS: 14 (tredicesima + quattordicesima).
TAX SECTOR: terziario (same classification as IC35 autorimesse; bus rental companies fall under ATECO division 49 which uses terziario INPS rates).
SIMPLIFICATION: Una-tantum payment of 600 EUR at C2 (split June 2025 + Jan 2026) covering Jan-May 2025 gap is excluded: one-off, not a recurring salary element.

limitation.remediation: Pay the 600 EUR una tantum outside the engine or model it as an event.

notes.text: SIMPLIFICATION: Overtime bands not modeled (no standard rates found in public sources; article-specific complexity).
SIMPLIFICATION: salary tables sourced from kitech.it (dati proxy, verificare con testo ufficiale ANAV). No official CNEL PDF or ANAV archive source was found during research.

limitation.remediation: Verify the salary tables against the official ANAV CCNL text.

notes.text: APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

reviews.scope: The tabellari, contingenza and EDR of the eleven levels against the ANAV tables of the accordo of 6 October 2022, and the tranches and the EDR 2025 of the renewal of 23 May 2025.
findings: Allegato n. 2 of the accordo of 6 October 2022, published by ANAV (text layer): the tabellare of October 2023, the contingenza and the EDR of the eleven levels move from assumed to verified (33 values). The signed CCNL scan (Allegato n. 5, p. 83) prints the same table at low resolution.

The renewal of 23 May 2025 prints only the increments at C2 (60 EUR from July 2025, 100 EUR from August 2026, EDR 2025 of 40 EUR), to reparametrise on the scale 100-200: the tranches and the EDR 2025 of each level are derived (33 values), with the increment rounded once, as the Allegato n. 2 of 2022 adds the aumento a regime in its last column (C4: 729,09 + 67,16 = 796,25, not the 796,26 of the three rounded tranches).
The ruleset names the renewal published by ANAV, the employer signatory: source_type contracting_party; the aggregator sources (redigo.info, kitech.it) are dropped.

reviews.scope: The accrual rule of the tredicesima (fractions of a month) against the full CCNL text.
findings: Articolo 48 - Tredicesima mensilità, comma 2 (p. 81): "il lavoratore non in prova avrà diritto a tanti dodicesimi dell'ammontare della tredicesima mensilità per quanti sono i mesi di servizio prestato. Le frazioni di mese non superiori ai 14 giorni non saranno calcolate, mentre saranno considerate come mese intero se superiori ai 14 giorni.". Added: more_than 14 (the file applied the engine default, at least 15 days).

provenance.note: Number of monthly payments read from the contract file; no clause is cited for it.
